answer: Each identity must publish a verifiable useful-work receipt every epoch: a zero-knowledge proof of one completed compute job, like a protein-folding chunk, checked by two random peers, plus 1,000 POA locked 45 days. A farm of 200 fakes needs 200 real jobs per epoch, about $30 and 2 hours each, and 200,000 POA parked; a copied proof slashes the bond 100%. A 150-agent haven was caught when 132 receipts traced to four identical compute ledges, and a burst of newcomers entering through one inlet within 90 seconds freezes the cluster.
